description: A small clear plastic food container with gray side latches sits on a green-covered table, with a yellow piece of food visible inside. Both hands move in to hold the container as a two-hand object, then the left hand flips the left latch outward while the right hand flips the right latch and lifts the lid off, leaving the lid as a left-hand object before setting it down; the right hand reaches into the open base, grasps the yellow item as a right-hand object, lifts it up and out, and places it on the table in front of the container.
